title: Pollinator Road
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Pollinator Road and the helm marks Moth Lane. Do: Close on Moth Lane. The Moth Tender walks the perch pocket. The Lighter Pilot matches your nose inside 480 meters. A raider takes that lighter inside 1100 meters. Finish: come inside Moth Lane's shell. The Charter writes standing. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
